summary: Practise beneficiary-data risk reviews, data-flow mapping, and sharing controls. Explore this five-day data privacy training course.
lede: Data protection in social protection systems governs how personal information is handled across eligibility decisions and service delivery. For registry officers, programme managers and privacy staff, training develops practical skills to map data flows, review access and sharing risks, document decisions about data use and retention, and manage beneficiary requests to access or correct their records.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who handle or oversee personal information in social registries, benefit administration, case management, and service oversight. It is designed for intermediate-level practitioners with responsibility for beneficiary-data decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social protection programme operations, beneficiary records, or information governance is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
